sentences: rs1815739 creates a stop‑gained (nonsense) change in ACTN3 (p.Arg577Ter) [F2].

The T allele (C>T) is present on 45% of alleles in gnomAD v4 exomes (651404/1461372) and its frequency varies by ancestry, reaching 65% in Admixed American and 16% in African/African American individuals [F4, F5].

ClinVar’s highest‑reviewed submission classifies the variant as benign for ACTININ, ALPHA‑3 POLYMORPHISM, though it is also noted to affect ACTN3 deficiency and two lower‑review submissions label it pathogenic, indicating disagreement [F6, F7, F8].
